story_info.title: Oliver Fox and the Chime Challenge
story_info.subtitle: A Story of Teamwork and Friendship
story_info.moral: Friends help each other and work together.

main_character.name: Oliver Fox
main_character.appearance: Oliver is a slim young fox with bright orange-red fur, a fluffy white-tipped tail, and perky triangular ears. He has clever amber eyes and a playful, confident grin.

supporting_characters.name: Squeaky Squirrel
supporting_characters.appearance: Squeaky is a small grey squirrel with a bushy tail and bright eyes.
supporting_characters.role: Helps Oliver reach a high branch, working as a team.

cover.visual_action: Oliver Fox and Squeaky Squirrel hanging wind chimes

slides.title: A Chime Surprise
slides.text: Oliver Fox skipped into Sunny Forest. The sun peeked through the leaves. He had pretty wind chimes in his paw. Oliver wanted to hang them up high. A friend's surprise party was today! He saw a perfect tall branch. It was just right.
slides.speaker_notes: Introduce Oliver and his mission in Sunny Forest.

slides.title: Too High to Reach
slides.text: Oliver jumped up to reach. He stretched his paw. The branch was too far away. He tried again with a bigger jump. Still, it was too high. Oliver felt a little stuck. He really wanted to hang the chimes. He thought and thought.
slides.speaker_notes: Show Oliver facing a challenge, feeling a little frustrated.

slides.title: A Friend Appears
slides.text: Just then, Squeaky Squirrel scampered past. "Hello, Oliver!" she chirped. Oliver showed her the chimes. "I need to hang these," he said. "But the branch is too high!" Squeaky looked at the branch. She looked at Oliver. She saw his clever eyes.
slides.speaker_notes: Introduce Squeaky and the shared problem.

slides.title: Let's Solve it Together!
slides.text: Oliver smiled his big, playful grin. "Let's solve it together!" he said. "You are small and quick. I am tall and strong." Squeaky got a bright idea. "I can stand on your shoulders!" she said. "Then I can reach!"
slides.speaker_notes: Oliver uses his catchphrase, and they devise a plan.

slides.title: Teamwork Makes it Work
slides.text: Oliver stood very still. Squeaky climbed gently onto his shoulders. She held the chimes carefully. Up she went, reaching for the branch. *Ting-a-ling!* The chimes hung perfectly. Oliver and Squeaky cheered. They had worked together as a team!
slides.speaker_notes: Show them successfully working together and solving the problem.

slides.title: Happy Friends
slides.text: The chimes sparkled in the afternoon sun. Oliver and Squeaky felt very happy. Their friendship felt even stronger. They knew they could always help each other. Working together made everything fun and easy. It was a lovely day in Sunny Forest.
slides.speaker_notes: Conclude with a warm, reassuring ending about friendship and teamwork.
